item: CI: timeout-minutes on the five jobs that had none (R475)
summary: test and core-only legs 75 min, crypto 20, columnar 30, lockfile-install 30: a hung job otherwise held a runner slot for the default six hours while runner queue time (49 to 110 min per job on 2026-11-07, run 42406622590) was the bottleneck. Caps are over 2x the slowest measured run (shards 26 to 31 min, crypto 1, columnar 2.5, lockfile 1.5); the timeout clock does not count queue time. A pip cache (cache: pip keyed on pyproject.toml) was built and DROPPED after the Opus read: setup-python keys the cache by OS, Python version and the pyproject hash only, so every Ubuntu job shares one key, the first job to finish (a one-minute job with a small wheel set) saves it and the three test shards would still download their segmentation, pdf, ocr and geo wheels on every run. Left on pull requests on purpose: the SQLCipher newest observation leg (about 9 min), because moving it needs a fromJSON matrix and two pins that grep the literal matrix.
